name: Bondo Foujaa
original_name: ボンド・フォージャー
source:
The Forger family's pet. A large, fluffy, white dog.
He was used in the past as a test animal in experiments, which resulted in giving him the ability  to see into the future.

[From [url=https://promo.shonenjump.com/spyfamily/14cp/doorway/]official site[/url]]
